partner_result.applied_statement: For independent cap-one U,V, ||p_{UV}||_3 <= 2 sqrt(3). Applied to bound the half-Riesz potential at the exact pure-saddle Schur endpoint.

mathematical_change.summary: For a nonsingular two-coordinate quadratic residual with D=|det S| and a nonzero physical diagonal c, proved P(|R-t|<=eps)<=25.4 |c|^(-1/6)D^(-1/3)eps^(5/6), hence sup_t E|R-t|^(-1/2)<17.5 |c|^(-1/10)D^(-1/5). Under max diagonal >= kappa sqrt(D), this is <=17.5 kappa^(-1/10)D^(-1/4). After a physical scalar pivot this yields a bounded-density principal-triple certificate. The exact pure-saddle endpoint is also paid using the partner L3 product-density theorem.

unresolved_implication: Remove the near-pure-saddle cross-dominance loss 0<max(|S_11|,|S_22|)<<sqrt(|det S|), or obtain an aggregate product-preserving certificate forced by the three-large-eigenvalue hypothesis.
